people.name: Moses
people.line: Prophet who led Israel out of Egypt

translations.web: Now in our law, Moses commanded us to stone such women. What then do you say about her?”
translations.bsb: In the Law Moses commanded us to stone such a woman. So what do You say?”
translations.kjv: Now Moses in the law commanded us, that such should be stoned: but what sayest thou?
translations.asv: Now in the law Moses commanded us to stone such: what then sayest thou of her?
